plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/karanb192/cache-tax @ 06cac47 (MIT). Warns before a cold prompt-cache send; /keepwarm.

plugins.name: hw-write-guard
plugins.description: Asks before code that drives hardware (nidaqmx DO/AO, pymodbus, pyserial, printer MQTT) runs or is written.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Skin: [SYS]/[TOOL]/[EDIT] rows with icons and one status block (in flightdeck under its session log when open, else above the prompt): [SYS] repo, branch, model, hw-guard; [CTL] model and effort buttons; [CTX] context fill with a /ctx pane by tool. /clean checklist view.

plugins.name: shared-edit-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another tool (e.g. Gemini) changed in the last few minutes.

plugins.name: reflect-lite
plugins.description: Offers to save your corrections as rules (CLAUDE.md or a skill). Local matching, no model calls.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/johnnyvizz/claude-kit/plugins/savvy-progress @ 272a877 (MIT). Subagent panel (/agents-info) + progress bar.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/zycck/claude-mods/plugins/plan-progress @ 3539d02 (MIT). Plan progress bars with subagent strips.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/scasella/claude-flightdeck @ f31daca (MIT), patched so other mods can draw under its session log. Live pane: subagents, permission verdicts, context, cost.

plugins.name: cc-arcade
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/sezaakgun/cc-arcade @ 0baff06 (MIT). Games and a pet above the prompt (/arcade).

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/data-goblin/claude-code-filetree @ da1da65 (MIT). Right-side file tree; touched files highlighted, green when committed.

plugins.name: redact
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/karanb192/claude-code-redact/plugins/redact @ 66e80ae (MIT). Swaps secrets in prompts for placeholders; restores them only in file edits.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/BayramAnnakov/claude-reflect/mod @ b6c4232 (MIT). Model-assisted correction capture (Haiku per prompt). Kept disabled; reflect-lite replaces it.

plugins.name: git-changes
plugins.description: /changes pane: branch, ahead/behind, staged, unstaged, untracked and conflicted files with +/- counts, recent commits. Read-only git.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Claude ends a turn with 2-4 follow-ups as buttons above the prompt; a click sends one.

plugins.name: qa-jump
plugins.description: /qa pane: your questions with the start of each answer; click to jump the transcript there.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Vendored from anthropic claude-code-playground @ 569c528 (Apache-2.0), patched so its band row stacks above other mods' rows (or sits in flightdeck). Step through last turn's edits (/replay).

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Vendored from anthropic claude-code-playground @ 569c528 (Apache-2.0). Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, migrations) with Proceed/Cancel.

plugins.name: agent-governor
plugins.description: Watches subagents: running count, peak and new tokens per agent in a band row; warns past limits. Hard caps and per-type model routing opt-in (/governor).

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Writes a handoff note at every compaction (goal, open tasks, files, errors), asks the summary to keep them, offers Resume in a fresh session. /handoff writes one now.

plugins.name: retry-breaker
plugins.description: Warns when Claude or a subagent fails the same command 3x in a row (busy port, timeout, flaky test). Never blocks.

plugins.name: chat-bubbles
plugins.description: Vendored from github.com/angeldelbiondo/claude-chat-bubbles @ 5597448 (MIT), patched so the footer keeps other mods' buttons. Messenger-style chat: your prompts in right-side bubbles, Claude in tinted cards, 441 palettes (/bubbles).

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Picks the model per prompt with local rules (no model calls): quick questions to Haiku, writing and explaining to Sonnet, building and fixing to Opus, only while the context is small. [AUTO] row with Redo; /automodel.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: /improve <prompt>: clickable questions in a pane, then a fuller prompt to run, edit or copy. Two small model calls per use, only when asked.

plugins.name: todays-report
plugins.description: /report: tasks Claude finished today, week, month or year, time worked, kinds of work, models, API-equivalent cost, streak, and an estimate of time saved at your rate. Local counts, no model calls.
